lines.zh: 我巡这片浅滩，找落单的鱼。
lines.en: I patrol these shallows for a straggling fish.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底追，骨粉从鳃边落。
lines.en: I chase along the riverbed, bone meal trailing my gills.
Its long snout splits the water open.
One flick of the tail sends it far.

lines.zh: 细长的身子在水草间穿行。
lines.en: Its slim body weaves through the weeds.

lines.zh: 它冒头换了口气，又下去。
lines.en: It surfaces for air, then sinks again.
Its scales scrape the river stones.

lines.zh: 水面上只留下一圈波纹。
lines.en: Only a ring of ripples marks its passing.
It hugs the bank, working the shallows.
My long snout hugs the riverbed.

lines.zh: 长嘴一动不动，像根沉木。
lines.en: My long snout stays still as sunken wood.

lines.zh: 我悬在沉木边，等鱼自己来。
lines.en: I hover by the sunken log, waiting for fish.

lines.zh: 它藏在沉木下，一动不动。
lines.en: It hides under a sunken log, still as stone.

lines.zh: 长吻朝上游，等着什么漂来。
lines.en: Its snout faces upstream, waiting for drift.

lines.zh: 它在水草里悬着，像根木头。
lines.en: It hangs in the weeds like a branch.

lines.zh: 鳃盖轻轻开合，一下一下。
lines.en: Its gill covers open and close, slow and even.
My long snout arrives first, underwater.

lines.zh: 我的牙一排排，收不回去。
lines.en: My rows of teeth cannot be drawn back.

lines.zh: 你的小腿在水里，太显眼了。
lines.en: Your calf in the water stands out too much.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，长吻够不到了。
lines.en: You retreat ashore — my snout cannot reach.

lines.zh: 长嘴浮在浅水，牙露在外面。
lines.en: My long snout floats shallow, teeth out.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先绷紧，再发力。
lines.en: My tail tightens first, then strikes.

lines.zh: 沉木下，我的眼珠转向你。
lines.en: Under the sunken log, my eye turns to you.

lines.zh: 身上多处受伤，行动不便...
被撞了一下，它猛地窜开。
它翻了个身，尾巴拍在你腿上。
lines.en: It rolls and slaps your leg with its tail.

lines.zh: 两条长吻并排，向深水去。
lines.en: Two long snouts side by side head for deep water.

lines.zh: 两条长吻并排游进深水。
lines.en: Two long snouts swim side by side into the deep.

lines.zh: 这具鱼身，我拖回沉木下。
lines.en: I drag this catch under the sunken log.
Do not touch my scales — their edges cut.
My bones are hard, very tough!
One snap of my long jaws and you're gone.

lines.zh: 长吻一张，河水都往里灌。
lines.en: My snout opens and river water pours in.
My long snout is a row of needles.

lines.zh: 我这张长嘴，就是为咬合生的。
lines.en: This long snout was built for biting down.

lines.zh: 你踩乱河沙，我已经知道了。
lines.en: You muddied the river sand; I already know.

lines.zh: 我这张长嘴，一开就合不上。
lines.en: Once my long jaws open, they do not close empty.
You will be my only prey!

lines.zh: 水下一道影子转向了你。
lines.en: A shape under the water turns toward you.

lines.zh: 它闻到血在水里化开了。
lines.en: It tastes blood spreading in the water.

lines.zh: 长吻贴着河底，牙尖先探出去。
lines.en: My long snout skims the riverbed, needle teeth first.
The fangs in my long snout are lined up.
My long snout is full of tiny teeth.

lines.zh: 我的长吻已经对准你的脚踝。
lines.en: My long snout is already aimed at your ankle.
It circles half around your feet.
Its snout lines up with your calf.

lines.zh: 它慢慢升到水面下一点。
lines.en: It rises to just beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 咔嚓！”，鳄鱼鱼嘴合拢的声音。
lines.en: Crunch! The sound of its jaw closing.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它露出锋利的牙齿。

lines.en: Water splashes as it leaps out of the water.

lines.zh: 它在水中快速滑行，逼近猎物。
lines.en: It glides through the water, closing in on its prey.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在阳光下闪耀。
lines.en: Its scales glimmer in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛死死盯着猎物不放。
lines.en: Its eyes fixed on its prey.
It lunges and bites the prey.

lines.zh: 它用有力的尾巴保持平衡。
lines.en: It uses its powerful tail for balance.

lines.zh: 它吞下猎物，发出咕噜声。
lines.en: It swallows the prey, making a gurgling sound.

lines.zh: 长吻一合，咬住你的小腿！
lines.en: Its snout snaps shut on your calf!

lines.zh: 它甩头一扯，把你拖下水！
lines.en: It whips its head and drags you under!

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，它破壳而出。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks, and it hatches.
It slowly crawls out of the water.
Its head pokes out of the water.
It swims around in the water.
It searches the shore for food.
At night, it dives into the water.

lines.zh: 它在淤泥中翻滚，寻找猎物。
lines.en: It rolls in the muck, searching for prey.
It basks in the sun by the river.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子寻找水中的猎物。
lines.en: It snouts for prey in the water.
It waits quietly at the bottom of the water.

lines.zh: 浅水里游来一条史前的鱼。
lines.en: A prehistoric fish slides into the shallows.

lines.zh: 水面炸开，它跃出来又沉下。
lines.en: The surface bursts as it leaps and dives.

lines.zh: 它在河湾的淤泥里现身。
lines.en: It appears in the silt of the river bend.

lines.zh: 卵石缝里钻出细长的身影。
lines.en: A slim shape slips out from between the stones.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我的鳃盖紧闭。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; my gill covers clamp shut.
A crack split my hard scales.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进鳞缝，我猛地摆尾。
lines.en: Magic seeps between my scales; I thrash.

lines.zh: 肚子空空，游得越来越慢。
lines.en: Empty-bellied, it swims slower and slower.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我整条身子僵住。
lines.en: Lightning struck the river; my whole body locked.
